description: This file defines UI components for an Accordion interface in a React application, using @radix-ui/react-accordion primitives with custom styling and behavior.

methods.name: Accordion
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's Accordion Root, providing the container for accordion items.

methods.name: AccordionItem
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's Accordion Item, representing a single section in the accordion with custom styling.

methods.name: AccordionTrigger
methods.description: A React component for the clickable header of an accordion section, including an icon and styling for open/close state.

methods.name: AccordionContent
methods.description: A React component that displays the content of an accordion section, with animation and styling.
